subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails` be suppressed before mutating-tool warning handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: The PR's stated policy conflicts with existing tests and only changes a later branch that does not cover the common mutating exec/bash path, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent warning contract.

options.title: Clarify policy and revise patch
options.body: Decide the intended warning contract, then rework the branch ordering and tests to match it before merge.

options.title: Preserve visible detail warnings
options.body: Keep the current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail behavior and narrow or close the linked issue instead of merging this suppress-all patch.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmerged until the linked issue has a confirmed expected behavior and contributor proof.

recommendation.title: Clarify policy and revise patch
recommendation.body: Decide the intended warning contract, then rework the branch ordering and tests to match it before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and file history put this handle closest to the current warning-policy and mutation-helper surfaces that need the behavior decision.
